brand.name: Logistra
brand.description: End-to-end e-commerce fulfilment for teams ready to move inventory out of the founder's hands.

home.title: The work behind every order, handled.
home.body: From inventory receiving to final dispatch—and everything in between. Logistra runs the physical and digital fulfilment workflow so your team can focus on building the business.
home.audience: For D2C brands · marketplace sellers · regional businesses going online

workflowIntro.title: From first scan to final mile.
workflowIntro.body: Fulfilment is more than a box leaving a warehouse. It is a chain of small, important decisions. We keep the whole chain moving.

outcome.title: Keep building the brand.
outcome.body: Logistra gives growing businesses the processes, people and visibility to make fulfilment feel like a strength—not the thing that slows them down.

audienceIntro.title: Not too much. Not too little. Just right for where you are.
audienceIntro.body: You do not need an enterprise machine. You need an operation that understands your volume, your customers and your ambition.

audiences.title: Growing D2C brands
audiences.body: Stop spending evenings on stock counts and packing slips. Keep your attention on the brand.

audiences.title: Marketplace sellers
audiences.body: Bring orders from every channel into one calm, consistent fulfilment operation.

audiences.title: Regional businesses going online
audiences.body: Take an established business online without building a warehouse operation from scratch.

workflow.title: Receive
workflow.body: Every inbound shipment is counted, scanned and checked before it enters the system.

workflow.title: Store
workflow.body: Inventory is assigned a defined location, making stock easier to find and harder to lose.

workflow.title: Synchronise
workflow.body: Orders from the channels you already use flow into one fulfilment queue.

workflow.title: Pick & pack
workflow.short: Every order follows a controlled process.
workflow.body: Reserve, pick, verify, pack, weigh and label—each order moves through the same considered sequence.

workflow.title: Ship
workflow.body: Shipments are created, manifested and handed over with tracking and exception visibility.

workflow.title: Return
workflow.short: The workflow continues when orders come back.
workflow.body: Returns and RTOs are inspected, classified and routed back into inventory—not left as a pile of exceptions.

services.name: Inbound receiving
services.description: Receive, count, scan and verify inventory as it enters the operation.

services.name: Storage
services.description: Organised SKU-level storage with location tracking and clear inventory states.

services.name: Pick & pack
services.description: Barcode-assisted picking, verification and professional packing for every order.

services.name: Dispatch
services.description: Courier handover, manifests, shipment tracking and exception monitoring.

services.name: Returns & RTO
services.description: Inspection, classification, restocking and quarantine built into the workflow.

services.name: COD reconciliation
services.description: Shipment-level remittance tracking and exception management.

services.name: Kitting & value-add
services.description: Bundling, relabelling, inserts, quality checks and custom packaging.

why.title: Accurate inventory
why.body: Controlled, SKU-level operations from receiving to return.

why.title: Transparent operations
why.body: See orders, inventory, fulfilment and returns in one view.

why.title: Built for growing teams
why.body: Professional systems for businesses that are not ready for enterprise complexity.

why.title: Returns under control
why.body: Reverse logistics is part of the workflow, not an afterthought.

onboarding.title: Tell us about your business
onboarding.body: Share your order volume, SKUs, channels and current fulfilment setup.

onboarding.title: We understand the operation
onboarding.body: We look at your products, packaging, storage and returns profile.

onboarding.title: Inventory moves to Logistra
onboarding.body: We receive, verify, locate and add your inventory to the system.

onboarding.title: Connect your channels
onboarding.body: Your orders begin flowing into one connected fulfilment workflow.

onboarding.title: We fulfil
onboarding.body: Pick → verify → pack → ship. A consistent process for every order.

onboarding.title: You monitor
onboarding.body: Stay close to inventory, orders, returns, RTO and performance.

howItWorks.title: A calmer way to move every order.
howItWorks.body: A controlled fulfilment workflow, from the first inbound scan to the moment a return finds its way back into sellable stock.
howItWorks.returnTitle: When an order comes back, the work continues.
howItWorks.returnBody: Returned shipments are inspected, classified and routed to the right next step—restock, repack, quarantine or investigation.

services.title: Everything your order needs between click and customer.
services.body: A hands-on fulfilment operation for the moments that matter: getting stock right, getting orders out, and keeping returns from becoming a blind spot.
services.introTitle: A practical operation, end to end.
services.introBody: Choose the pieces you need today. Build from there as your business grows.

valuePoints.title: Operations you can explain
valuePoints.body: Clear steps, defined owners and fewer “where is that order?” moments.

valuePoints.title: Stock you can trust
valuePoints.body: Inventory states are visible from available to returned and quarantined.

valuePoints.title: Returns with a next step
valuePoints.body: Every returned unit is inspected and routed back into the workflow.

technology.title: The operation, with nothing hidden.
technology.body: Technology at Logistra has one job: make the physical work more reliable, visible and easier to act on.
technology.platformTitle: One view of the work behind the order.
technology.platformBody: Orders, inventory, picking, shipping, returns and RTO are connected to the operation—not floating separately from it.
technology.integrationTitle: Connected to the channels you already use.
technology.integrationBody: Orders from multiple channels should not create multiple versions of the truth. Bring them into one workflow.
technology.futureTitle: Useful data, when it is ready.
technology.futureBody: We are interested in what the data can make better—demand forecasts, RTO prediction, smarter slotting and clearer profitability. These are planned capabilities, not claims about today.

about.title: Built around the realities of growing brands.
about.body: Logistra exists for the point where fulfilment has become too important to improvise, but too personal to hand to a faceless machine.
about.statementBody: We believe the best fulfilment partner is not the one with the loudest claims. It is the one that knows where your inventory is, what your customer needs, and what should happen next.
about.principlesBody: A reliable operation is a business advantage. We treat it that way.

principles.title: Stay close to the work
principles.body: Good fulfilment is built on what happens on the floor. We keep the process concrete, visible and connected to the people doing it.

principles.title: Make the next step clear
principles.body: Every order, unit and return should have an obvious status and an obvious next move.

principles.title: Grow at the right pace
principles.body: We are here for the businesses moving from founder-led fulfilment to a repeatable operation.

about.originBody: Logistra understands the ambition of businesses that are growing out of regional markets and reaching customers across India. We bring operational discipline without losing that closeness.

contact.title: Let’s see if Logistra fits your operation.
contact.body: Tell us a little about your business. We’ll come back with the right questions, not a generic pitch.
